fields.quoted_span: No landlord shall bring any action to recover possession of a dwelling unit as a reprisal for the tenant's efforts to secure or enforce any right under this chapter.
fields.note: The policy statement in § 19:2-1(d) does mention fear of eviction without just cause. Section 19:2-14 and the rest of the chapter list no eviction causes, notice periods or relocation assistance.

fields.note: The summary matches the § 19:2-2.1 applicability rule and the § 19:2-2 exemptions list. The unverifiable exemptions match the exemption text and § 19:2-18.2.
